# Zafran Security (Zafran Security Ltd.)

Zafran Security is a Computer and Network Security company. Zafran is an AI-Native Threat Exposure Management Platform that helps security teams buried in vulnerabilities and manual work to unify vulnerability findings and create a unified view of exposure across their existing tools. Zafran Security employs 141 people (+59.6% YoY, +68 people). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Israel, and Germany. Has $136M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

## About

Zafran is an AI-native exposure management platform that eliminates the manual toil of vulnerability management by cutting through noise, revealing what is truly exploitable, and automating mitigation and remediation using the security controls teams already have.

We are a team of practitioners and builders shaped by high-stakes security moments, where clarity and speed mattered, and manual processes came at a real cost.

We’re on a mission to proactively stop the exploitation of vulnerabilities, everywhere.

# Zafran Announces Strategic Investment from Cisco Investments

Author:

Zafran Team

,

Published on

July 22, 2026

Blog

Zafran Security, a pioneer in AI-native Continuous Threat Exposure Management, today announced a strategic investment from Cisco Investments, extending its previously announced $130 million total funding. Cisco Investments joins existing investors including Sequoia Capital, Cyberstarts, Menlo Ventures, PSP Growth, Vintage Investment Partners, and Amex Ventures.

The investment comes as enterprise security reaches an inflection point. AI is fundamentally changing how attacks are executed, enabling attackers to chain together multiple low-severity weaknesses into sophisticated attack paths at machine speed. As the time between vulnerability disclosure and exploitation continues to shrink, organizations have an extremely urgent situation to find vulnerability risk and remediate it before attackers do. They need to understand how attackers are most likely to move through their environment and reduce exploitable risk before those attack paths can be used.

At the same time, enterprises have spent decades building best-in-class security programs. EDR, firewalls, cloud security platforms, identity systems, vulnerability scanners and countless other technologies all play an important role in defending the business. ## Zafran - About the company

Zafran is a series C company based in New York City (United States), founded in 2022 by Snir Havdala and Sanaz Yashar. It operates as a Security risk mitigation platform. Zafran has raised $130M in funding from investors like Sequoia Capital, Menlo Ventures and Cyberstarts. The company has 96 active competitors, including 20 funded and 23 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like incident.io, BreachRx and Cado Security.

### Company Details

Security risk mitigation platform. The tool that combines control configurations, runtime data, internet exposures, and threat intelligence to assess applicable risk and implement mitigations. It offers agentless inspection of assets, controls, vulnerabilities, and threats through API integration with organizations' security tools.

# Zafran Triples ARR in $60M Round to Reinvent Exposure Management with Agentic AI

Led by Menlo Ventures with participation from Sequoia Capital and Cyberstarts, Zafran is doubling its valuation since the last round to advance the mission of stopping vulnerability exploitation everywhere.

Author:

Zafran Team

,

Published on

December 2, 2025

Blog

‍New York, New York – December 2, 2025 – Zafran Security, the pioneer in AI-native Threat Exposure Management, today announced a $60 million Series C funding round led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from existing investors Sequoia Capital and Cyberstarts, in addition to PSP Growth, Vintage Investment Partners, and Knollwood Investment. By launching Agentic Exposure Management, Zafran is now poised to complete the entire end-to-end lifecycle across asset inventory, vulnerability detection, risk assessment, and autonomous remediation workflows.

This round brings the company’s total funding to $130 million. The new capital will accelerate product innovation and global expansion as Zafran advances its mission to stop the exploitation of vulnerabilities, everywhere.
